users_analytics_consent_complete.name: users_analytics_consent_complete
users_analytics_consent_complete.value: ("users"."analytics_consent" IS NULL AND "users"."analytics_consent_at" IS NULL AND "users"."analytics_consent_source" IS NULL) OR ("users"."analytics_consent" IS NOT NULL AND "users"."analytics_consent_at" IS NOT NULL AND "users"."analytics_consent_source" IS NOT NULL)

items_event_payload_chk.name: items_event_payload_chk
items_event_payload_chk.value: "items"."type"::text <> 'event' OR coalesce(jsonb_typeof("items"."payload"->'allDay') = 'boolean' AND jsonb_typeof("items"."payload"->'start') = 'string' AND jsonb_typeof("items"."payload"->'timeZone') = 'string' AND (NOT "items"."payload" ? 'location' OR char_length("items"."payload"->>'location') <= 200) AND jsonb_typeof("items"."payload"#>'{notify,before}') = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length("items"."payload"#>'{notify,before}') <= 3, false)

items_cover_chk.name: items_cover_chk
items_cover_chk.value: "items"."cover" IS NULL OR ("items"."type"::text IN ('text','reminder','event','table','calc') AND jsonb_typeof("items"."cover") = 'object' AND coalesce(jsonb_typeof("items"."cover"->'publicId') = 'string', false) AND char_length("items"."cover"->>'publicId') BETWEEN 1 AND 255 AND (NOT "items"."cover" ? 'width' OR jsonb_typeof("items"."cover"->'width') = 'number') AND (NOT "items"."cover" ? 'height' OR jsonb_typeof("items"."cover"->'height') = 'number'))

link_checks_flagged_idx.name: link_checks_flagged_idx
link_checks_flagged_idx.where: "link_checks"."flagged_at" IS NOT NULL AND "link_checks"."dismissed_at" IS NULL

link_checks_dismissed_chk.name: link_checks_dismissed_chk
link_checks_dismissed_chk.value: "link_checks"."dismissed_at" IS NULL OR "link_checks"."flagged_at" IS NOT NULL

waitlist_pending_has_token.name: waitlist_pending_has_token
waitlist_pending_has_token.value: "waitlist_entries"."status" <> 'pending' OR ("waitlist_entries"."confirm_token_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "waitlist_entries"."confirm_expires_at" IS NOT NULL)

waitlist_confirmed_has_time.name: waitlist_confirmed_has_time
waitlist_confirmed_has_time.value: "waitlist_entries"."status" NOT IN ('confirmed', 'invited') OR "waitlist_entries"."confirmed_at" IS NOT NULL
